title: Lake Resort/ Boat Docks
content: Has anyone been to a place outside the Mall that appears similar to Lake Havasu? I had a genuine sense I was just “down the road” from the Mall but even had the odd thought that this is like Lake Havasu. This is strange in that I have never been there in real life and barely have watched a travel program on it years ago. I spent most of my time around the luxury boat docks and conversing with familiar strangers and appreciating the different yachts. The familiar strangers concept is odd as well. I know these people in the dream, I wake up and have only vague remembrance of the faces but not names.
